import java.util.*;
public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXNODES = 5005;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 4 * MAXNODES * (int)Math.sqrt(MAXNODES);
    static final int INF_VAL = 1000000000;
    static class FlowStruct {
        int c, f;
        FlowStruct(int c, int f) {
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, val, w;
        Edge(int to, int next, int val, int w) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.val = val;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static int n, m, k, c, d, s, t, totalCount, edgeCounter;
    static int[] pre = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXNODES];
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXEDGES << 1];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXNODES];
    static boolean[] inQ = new boolean[MAXNODES];
    static int[][] E = new int[MAXNODES][2];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        edgeCounter++;
        edges[edgeCounter] = new Edge(v, head[u], val, w);
        head[u] = edgeCounter;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        connect(u, v, val, w);
        connect(v, u, 0, -w);
    }

    static boolean bellmanFord() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 1, totalCount + 1, INF_VAL);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                if (edges[i].val > 0 && dist[v] > dist[u] + edges[i].w) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + edges[i].w;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < INF_VAL;
    }

    static FlowStruct minCostFlow() {
        int totalFlowC = 0, totalFlowF = 0;
        while (bellmanFord()) {
            int flowCap = INF_VAL;
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
                flowCap = Math.min(flowCap, edges[pre[x]].val);
            }
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
                edges[pre[x]].val -= flowCap;
                edges[pre[x] ^ 1].val += flowCap;
            }
            totalFlowF += flowCap;
            totalFlowC += dist[t] * flowCap;
        }
        return new FlowStruct(totalFlowC, totalFlowF);
    }

    static int IDX3(int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        int startIdx = 2 * k;
        totalCount = startIdx * n;
        s = ++totalCount;
        t = ++totalCount;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int tp = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(s, IDX3(0, tp), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            E[i][0] = sc.nextInt();
            E[i][1] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= startIdx - 1; i++) {
            addEdge(IDX3(i, 1), t, k, c * i);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdge(IDX3(i - 1, j), IDX3(i, j), k, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int tIdx = 1; tIdx <= k; tIdx++) {
                    addEdge(IDX3(i - 1, E[j][0]), IDX3(i, E[j][1]), 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                    addEdge(IDX3(i - 1, E[j][1]), IDX3(i, E[j][0]), 1, (2 * tIdx - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(minCostFlow().c);
        sc.close();
    }
}
